allowed: versioned provider bundles committed in the source-of-truth repository
offline clean-copy smoke tests without provider credentials
requiresSeparateAuthorization: installation into user or admin directories
public release or repository visibility changes
distributionBoundary.licenseBoundary: Source artifacts are public-ready under the repository Apache-2.0 license; publication, marketplace registration, and repository visibility changes remain separately authorized operations.

sharedCore.rule: Schemas, deterministic scripts, fixtures, gate semantics, and evidence validation live once in the provider-neutral core.
sharedCore.adapterRule: Provider bundles contain discovery metadata and thin invocation instructions only; they cannot fork business rules or verification semantics.
sharedCore.versionRule: Every provider bundle records the same shared core version and fails validation on version drift.

officialSources.claim: Repository skills use a SKILL.md directory and Codex discovers repo skills under .agents/skills.
A distributable plugin requires .codex-plugin/plugin.json and may contain skills, MCP configuration, assets, and hooks.

providers.agentBoundary: Codex uses skill workflows plus the host's bounded subagent capability; no invented provider manifest is required for a standalone agent.

officialSources.claim: A Claude Code plugin uses .claude-plugin/plugin.json with skills and agents at the plugin root.
Skills live under skills/<name>/SKILL.md and custom agents live under agents/*.md with YAML frontmatter.

providers.agentBoundary: Agents provide isolated context and tool limits; plugin skills remain namespaced and refer to the shared core contracts.
validation: local --plugin-dir discovery smoke when separately authorized

officialSources.claim: Project skills are supported under .github/skills, .claude/skills, or .agents/skills and use the open Agent Skills format.
Custom agents use Markdown profiles with required description and supported YAML frontmatter.
Repository custom agents live under .github/agents as .agent.md files.

providers.agentBoundary: No fabricated Copilot plugin manifest is introduced. The installable unit is a versioned repository bundle of official project skills and custom-agent profiles.
providers.previewBoundary: Prompt files are optional because their support remains surface-specific and preview; they are not the primary workflow contract.

crossProviderAcceptance: Exactly one Codex, one Claude, and one Copilot provider entry exists.
Every official source uses an authoritative provider documentation host.
Each provider declares both Project Intelligence and Workflow Orchestrator surfaces.
No provider adapter is allowed to contain shared business rules or weaken gate/evidence semantics.
No installation, publication, sync, push, or external execution occurs during input preparation.
